column1: # Stage S13 W1, third of four: the host agent leaves `apps/` and becomes the crate
# game_server_host_agent in the new crate category `crates/fleet/`, beside the fleet command
# vocabulary of `crates/contracts/fleet_wire_contract`; its documentation mirror moves with it
# under `documentation/crates/fleet/game_server_host_agent`, and its systemd template takes the
# crate's name (`deploy/systemd/game_server_host_agent@.service`).
# The package, library and binary rename (`fleet_host_agent` -> `game_server_host_agent`) is in the
# crate's manifest. The crate path `fleet_host_agent::` becomes `game_server_host_agent::` in the
# two places that name the library: the binary's entry file and the integration tests. The rows
# stop there: a one-segment prefix also matches the bare word in comments and string literals, and
# the library's own sources hold the HTTP user agent `fleet_host_agent/<version>`, a wire literal
# with its own decision. Recorded staging transcripts that name the old library's log targets are
# records and stay. Package names in commands (`-p fleet_host_agent`), the installed binary, the
# configuration folder and the unit instances have no `text` row: the host migration and the deploy
# code rename them.
